If Sean's wife drove at a constant speed and left just in time to meet the 9 pm plane, for how long did Sean walk before he was picked up?

The teacher cannot tell the girls apart so asks the other two sisters the name of the sister who was late. One of them says: ‘Antonia was late’, and the other says: ‘Dara was late’.
